name: Dynamic Global Rank
description: Displays an animated popup whenever the mod sees your global leaderboard rank update

popup-background-color.name: Background color
popup-background-color.description: Change the background color of the rank popup

popup-background-opacity.name: Background opacity
popup-background-opacity.description: Change the transparency of the popup background

show-after-level-complete.name: Show after level complete
show-after-level-complete.description: Show your rank update after completing a level and exiting

background-refresh.name: Background rank refresh
background-refresh.description: Enable to let the mod fetch and update your rank periodically, this can get annoying if you constantly move up or down 1 place!

refresh-seconds.name: Background refresh interval
refresh-seconds.description: How often to check your global rank in seconds. Lower values update faster but send more requests
